SELECT t.id AS trainerId, t.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.phone AS phoneNum, u.profile_image AS profileImg, t.trainer_type AS trainerType, t.approval_status AS approvalStatus, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.member_id) AS memberCount
FROM TRAINER t
JOIN `USER` u ON t.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_PT mp ON t.id = mp.trainer_id AND mp.status = 'active'
WHERE t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND u.is_deleted = false
AND ( u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(t.id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY t.id, t.user_id, u.name, u.phone, u.profile_image, t.trainer_type, t.approval_status
ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT tu.name AS trainerName, mu.name AS memberName, mp.register_date AS assignedAt, CONCAT('PT ', ms.type_rep, '회') AS membershipName, CONCAT(IFNULL(mp.lesson_count, 0), '회') AS remainingCount,
CASE WHEN mp.status = 'active' THEN '이용중' ELSE '종료' END AS status
FROM MEMBERSHIP_PT mp
JOIN TRAINER t ON mp.trainer_id = t.id
JOIN `USER` tu ON t.user_id = tu.id
JOIN MEMBER m ON mp.member_id = m.id
JOIN `USER` mu ON m.user_id = mu.id
JOIN MEMBERSHIP ms ON mp.membership_id = ms.id
WHERE t.gym_id = #{value} AND ms.type = 'pt'
ORDER BY mp.register_date DESC

SELECT u.name AS memberName, CONCAT('PT ', ms.type_rep, '회') AS membershipName, IFNULL(mp.lesson_count, 0) AS remainingSession, DATE_FORMAT(mp.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate
FROM MEMBERSHIP_PT mp
JOIN TRAINER t ON mp.trainer_id = t.id
JOIN MEMBER m ON mp.member_id = m.id
JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id
JOIN MEMBERSHIP ms ON mp.membership_id = ms.id
WHERE mp.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND mp.status = 'active' AND ms.type = 'pt'
ORDER BY mp.start_date DESC

SELECT u.name AS memberName, CONCAT('PT ', ms.type_rep, '회') AS membershipName, IFNULL(mp.lesson_count, 0) AS remainingSession, DATE_FORMAT(mp.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate
FROM MEMBERSHIP_PT mp
JOIN TRAINER t ON mp.trainer_id = t.id
JOIN MEMBER m ON mp.member_id = m.id
JOIN `USER` u ON m.user_id = u.id
JOIN MEMBERSHIP ms ON mp.membership_id = ms.id
WHERE mp.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND mp.status = 'expired' AND ms.type = 'pt'
ORDER BY mp.start_date DESC
